description: This is a Python source file for an audio handling module within a larger software project. It provides functions for extracting and embedding metadata, generating thumbnails from embedded cover art, and extracting audio fingerprints.

methods.name: audio_thumbnail
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail image from embedded cover art in an audio file.

methods.name: audio_meta_extract
methods.description: Extracts metadata from an audio file, including duration and tags.

methods.name: audio_meta_embed
methods.description: Embeds provided metadata into a copy of the audio file.

methods.name: audio_features_extract
methods.description: Extracts a chromaprint fingerprint and duration from an audio file.
